shall_requirement: Create an organization using an allowlisted display name; derive the initial owner membership from the authenticated actor
validation_or_security: Name trimmed 2–120 characters; reject empty, controls, forbidden fields
acceptance_behavior: Create org and owner membership atomically; return scoped org id

shall_requirement: List only organizations in which caller has an active verified membership; switch active org through server-verified membership
validation_or_security: No trust in client-supplied orgId; suspended/deleted membership not selectable
acceptance_behavior: Another tenant is never revealed or selected

shall_requirement: Invite an email to a bounded allowed role and track pending/accepted/expired/revoked invitations
validation_or_security: Email syntactically valid; invitation TTL and resend policy configurable
acceptance_behavior: Unapproved role or cross-org invite rejected; invitee accepts with verified identity

shall_requirement: Revoke or change a member role and invalidate authorization immediately on subsequent requests
validation_or_security: Cannot leave active organization without an authorized owner; no arbitrary super-admin grant
acceptance_behavior: Revoked member can neither list nor mutate tenant records

shall_requirement: Enforce organization membership and record-policy checks for every entity read, write, relation lookup, aggregate and export
validation_or_security: Org from verified session; resource org must match; check record owner/team policy
acceptance_behavior: Cross-tenant ID probes and list queries do not leak records

shall_requirement: Deny blanket platform support access to customer records unless a separately reviewed just-in-time support flow exists
validation_or_security: No implicit support impersonation; elevated actions are audited
acceptance_behavior: Internal platform user without org authorization sees no tenant records

shall_requirement: Expose purchased/enabled application grants and organization plan limits to an authorized role
validation_or_security: Entitlement comes from server-side status, not UI flags
acceptance_behavior: Disabled/expired/over-quota feature cannot be invoked by API

shall_requirement: Apply app entitlements, usage ceilings and relevant role checks on protected writes, batch operations and jobs
validation_or_security: Consistent atomic reservation/check on quotas when applicable
acceptance_behavior: Concurrent requests cannot bypass plan limit by racing

shall_requirement: Record immutable-meaning audit of critical actions and denied privileged attempts, scoped by org and actor
validation_or_security: Fields: actor, target ref, action, timestamp, outcome; redact secret values
acceptance_behavior: Who/what/when trace is retrievable by authorized reviewers only

shall_requirement: Provide a hosted payment-provider checkout/portal handoff after provider/legal terms are approved
validation_or_security: Never accept raw card or bank details in business API
acceptance_behavior: Sandbox may use mock billing status; no actual charge authorized

shall_requirement: Handle later approved billing-provider callbacks via verified signatures and idempotent state mapping
validation_or_security: Do not trust browser-reported payment success or unverified webhook
acceptance_behavior: Duplicate/out-of-order events do not activate unearned entitlements

shall_requirement: Create and edit a lead with name, company context, contact channel, source, assigned owner and allowed status
validation_or_security: Trim length, validate contact formats if present, validate owner membership
acceptance_behavior: Invalid lead is rejected without partial persistence

shall_requirement: List/search/filter leads within organization and assigned/team scope, with pagination and deterministic sort
validation_or_security: Bound page size; no public global search; escape search output
acceptance_behavior: Other org leads and private fields are absent from results

shall_requirement: Progress lead stage according to configured pipeline rules with tracked actor/time
validation_or_security: No arbitrary unsupported state value or out-of-scope edit
acceptance_behavior: Lead stage history records authorized change

shall_requirement: Create/update an Account with required name and optional permitted business metadata
validation_or_security: Account name 2–160 characters; no bank/identity/card fields
acceptance_behavior: Organization-scoped Account created and accessible only by allowed roles

shall_requirement: Create/update Contacts and associate them with same-organization Accounts, if permitted
validation_or_security: At least one usable contact field; bound lengths; relation org validation
acceptance_behavior: Cross-org account association rejected

shall_requirement: Warn on potential duplicate Account/Contact candidates within a tenant rather than silently merging
validation_or_security: Candidate match rules configurable; avoid global email uniqueness claims
acceptance_behavior: No automatic cross-tenant merge or disclosure

shall_requirement: Create a Deal linked to same-org Account/Contact, pipeline, stage, owner and optional Agent reference
validation_or_security: Validated existing relation IDs; required deal title and state
acceptance_behavior: Foreign/cross-tenant reference rejected

shall_requirement: Change deal stage only via authorized/valid transition and preserve activity history
validation_or_security: Optimistic version check on concurrent edits
acceptance_behavior: Conflicting writes return conflict/reload signal, not lost update

shall_requirement: Create, assign, reschedule and complete a task linked to authorized lead/account/deal
validation_or_security: Owner must be active allowed member; dates valid; audit actor
acceptance_behavior: Unauthorized task assignment or completion rejected

shall_requirement: Filter deals/tasks by owner, stage, age and due status with team-scoped counts
validation_or_security: Apply policy before aggregate/filter, not after
acceptance_behavior: Team lead totals reconcile to authorized underlying records

shall_requirement: Show individual workload without exposing a different team's restricted records
validation_or_security: Teams/permissions from server-side membership
acceptance_behavior: No cross-team side-channel from totals

shall_requirement: Accept only approved CSV column mappings and synthetically safe test datasets in sandbox
validation_or_security: Strict allowlist, known limit, scan/quarantine before real upload workflow
acceptance_behavior: Forbidden column or cross-org relation causes safe abort; no hidden partial import

shall_requirement: Export only permitted tenant/record fields after authorization with auditable request and expiring link if file delivery used
validation_or_security: PII/redacted fields policy; no unrestricted download path
acceptance_behavior: Another org's data never appears in a generated export

shall_requirement: Provide consistent loading/empty/validation/error/forbidden/expired UI states across CRUD/list forms
validation_or_security: Keyboard nav, accessible names, inline errors and focus placement
acceptance_behavior: Form failure does not silently drop unsaved user work

shall_requirement: Prevent accidental duplicate submissions and represent server outcomes consistently in desktop/mobile clients
validation_or_security: Disable/indicate pending; handle network timeout and conflict
acceptance_behavior: Retry does not unintentionally duplicate logical records

shall_requirement: Create merchant organization record plus optional location and link to same-org CRM lead/account/deal and assigned Agent
validation_or_security: Merchant name and tenant links validated; no raw KYC upload
acceptance_behavior: Merchant record tracks relationships without entering prohibited sensitive data

shall_requirement: Associate merchant with an internal Agent and retain assignment history after reassignment
validation_or_security: Agent belongs to org and current operator authorized
acceptance_behavior: Former agent scope is revoked immediately after reassignment

shall_requirement: Open an internal merchant application, assign operations owner, stage and next permissible action
validation_or_security: Unique opaque application ID; linked merchant required; no fabricated provider approval
acceptance_behavior: Application and initial stage history are atomic

shall_requirement: Create required next-action task and due date for a blocked/internal pending application
validation_or_security: Task owner authorized, date sensible, text length bounded
acceptance_behavior: Owner/action visible with case; no orphan task

shall_requirement: View stalled queue filtering status, age, assigned owner and next action
validation_or_security: Organization + record policy before filtering and counts
acceptance_behavior: Correct owner/internal stage/next action on seeded synthetic cases

shall_requirement: Show reason a case awaits further input and avoid claiming it is externally approved
validation_or_security: Only internal state may be edited in internal UI
acceptance_behavior: Blocked case and external unknown state not visually conflated

shall_requirement: Define organization-specific internal stages and valid transitions in configurable schema
validation_or_security: Reject invalid duplicate stage keys; changes versioned
acceptance_behavior: Unrecognized transitions return policy error and history unchanged

shall_requirement: Apply a validated stage transition with transactionally consistent history and future outbox event
validation_or_security: Actor authorized; current version matches expected; transition allowed
acceptance_behavior: Duplicate/retried transition does not duplicate history

shall_requirement: Maintain bounded non-sensitive application checklist status and timestamped actor trail
validation_or_security: Checklist item key, completion actor and permitted category
acceptance_behavior: Checklist completion never changes external processor status

shall_requirement: Create/disable Agent and agent-to-merchant relationships with tenant boundaries
validation_or_security: Do not accept external agent data without policy; prevent self-privilege
acceptance_behavior: Agent-scoped views cannot enumerate unrelated merchants

shall_requirement: Ensure agent reassignment and membership revocation invalidate old portfolio access and are audited
validation_or_security: Re-evaluate authorization on each relevant access
acceptance_behavior: Old relation/history preserved but old access denied

shall_requirement: Maintain a separate external processor status reference with source, observedAt and verification state
validation_or_security: No unverified callback may claim approved/boarded/active
acceptance_behavior: Internal 'approved' does not auto-enable charges or merchant activation

shall_requirement: Reject unsigned, invalid, replayed or out-of-order external event updates in later connector
validation_or_security: Require provider agreement and testable replay semantics
acceptance_behavior: A stale duplicate cannot overwrite verified newer state

shall_requirement: Provide tenant-scoped counts for awaiting info, internal review, pending external and activation follow-up
validation_or_security: Counts derive from currently accessible rows; refresh semantics documented
acceptance_behavior: Dashboard matches authorized list filters

shall_requirement: Present date-range, owner and stage filters with consistent empty and unavailable states
validation_or_security: Timezone and range semantics specified later; no cross-tenant rollup
acceptance_behavior: Invalid range rejected safely

shall_requirement: Load approved fictional tenant data for two organizations and at least five distinct merchant cases
validation_or_security: Only synthetic example.com records; no genuine provider credentials
acceptance_behavior: Stalled, declined and approved-not-active samples behave as expected

shall_requirement: Run negative scenarios for cross-tenant read, denied stage changes and prohibited fields once code exists
validation_or_security: Tests execute in CI against running services
acceptance_behavior: Zero unexpected access or secret logging in negative tests

shall_requirement: Direct processor onboarding connector deferred until contracts, API rights and security design are authorized
validation_or_security: No external provider secrets or webhook URLs in synthetic MVP
acceptance_behavior: Not marketed or exposed as live capability

shall_requirement: Residual statement import, commission calculation and payouts deferred pending real sample formats, reconciliation and approval
validation_or_security: No internal pseudo-payout flow presented as real
acceptance_behavior: No payout/finance endpoints in MVP

shall_requirement: Agent self-service portal deferred until external identity and record-scope review
validation_or_security: Internal agent association is not portal login
acceptance_behavior: No unaudited external agent invitation

shall_requirement: Hardware, serial numbers, technician dispatch and terminal provisioning deferred
validation_or_security: POS case tracking not presented as field-service execution
acceptance_behavior: No terminal provisioning in MVP

shall_requirement: Underwriting, full KYC/KYB and money movement deferred to separately scoped regulated systems
validation_or_security: Raw regulated fields prohibited in generic CRM
acceptance_behavior: No fake compliance approval

shall_requirement: Future major Zoho-like app families each require their own PRD, permissions, entitlements and release acceptance
validation_or_security: No claim all suite products are available
acceptance_behavior: Unreleased app remains disabled with honest roadmap state
